line: Crowley’s Four of Cups: Luxury, Chesed in the sphere of Water, the Moon in Cancer.

sections.title: What Crowley names
sections.line: The chapter name for the card. The second quotation gives the element of its suit.

quotes.quote: The Four of Cups is called Luxury.
“Wands”, attributed to Fire; “Cups”, to Water; “Swords”, to Air;

sections.title: Its place on the Tree and in the zodiac
sections.line: The card refers to Chesed in the sphere of Water, and to the Moon in Cancer, which is her own house.

quotes.quote: This card refers to Chesed in the sphere of Water.
The card refers to the Moon in Cancer, which is her own house

sections.title: What it figures
sections.line: Crowley reads the card below the Abyss as ordered Water that has lost its original purity.

quotes.quote: Here, below the Abyss, the energy of this element, although ordered, balanced and (for the moment) stabilized, has lost the original purity of the conception.
